newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil firmer with crude.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil firmer with crude.

text.p: NWE low sulphur straight-run fuel oil rose on Monday as crude surged on Iraq news, traders said.
An early September North Sea cargo was heard offered at around $128 a tonne fob NWE, around $4 up from Friday.
High sulphur cargoes were firmer, too, and dealers said the region was poorly supplied with product. E-4 cargoes were assessed at a $4 premium to the quotes m/m/m.

News that Russian Economy Minister Yevgeny Yasim was opposed to a winter fuel oil export limit, as threatened earlier by the energy ministry, failed to have much impact on prices, traders said. -- Nicholas Shaxson, London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
